instruction: From the homepage, click on the 'Research' link in the navigation bar to go to the Research Areas page. How many research areas are listed?
Navigate to the course detail page for CSE 446 (Machine Learning). Who is the instructor for this course?
Go to the Course Catalog page and search for courses containing the word 'data' using the search bar. How many courses are found?
Use the faculty semantic search to find faculty members related to 'distributed systems'. Who is the first result?
Search for courses containing the word 'programming' by navigating directly to the URL /sites/university-academic/courses/search/programming. How many courses are found?
On the Course Catalog page, use the Level dropdown to filter courses to show only 'advanced' level courses. How many advanced courses are listed?
Navigate directly to the URL /sites/university-academic/courses/level/intermediate to see intermediate-level courses. How many courses are shown?
Search the faculty directory for members who work in 'machine learning'. How many faculty members are found?
On the Course Catalog page, use the level checkboxes to select both 'introductory' and 'advanced' courses. How many courses are shown in total?
Go to the Compare Courses page and compare CSE 446 (Machine Learning) and CSE 473 (Introduction to Artificial Intelligence). What is the maximum enrollment for CSE 446?
Go to the faculty detail page for Dr. David Liu (fac-004). What is his office location?
On the Events page, filter events to show only those between 2025-10-01 and 2026-01-31. How many events fall within this date range?
Compare courses CSE 452 (Distributed Systems) and CSE 461 (Intro to Networks) using the compare page. Which course has the higher maximum enrollment?
Go to the Contact page and submit a message with subject 'Course Availability' and message 'When will CSE 452 be offered next?'. Confirm the submission was successful.
Go to the Apply page and submit an application with name 'Jane Doe', email 'jane@example.com', and select the 'machine-learning' program. Confirm the application was submitted successfully.
Go to the Export page and download the course catalog as CSV. How many data rows are in the exported CSV (not counting the header)?
Log in with NetID 'arivera', then go to the Subscriptions page and subscribe to the 'systems' research area. Verify the subscription was recorded.
From the homepage, click on the 'Machine Learning & AI' research area card to navigate to its detail page. How many active projects are listed for this research area?
Use the Research Area dropdown on the Course Catalog page to filter courses in the 'systems' area. How many systems courses are offered?

Log in with NetID 'nkim', then submit an application for the 'security' program with name 'Natalie Kim', email 'nkim@uw.edu', and statement 'I want to research browser security'. Verify the application was recorded for this user.
